summary: Scan-frontier pagination and DirtyDuringLoad invalidation for one subscriber session (R1 / commit 76af3a54): live non-inline publications 1..N admit monotonically while store commits and StoreResult notifications can arrive out of order, an arbitrary-low obligation (0) models retained replay / Will / shard clear, and bounded LoadWork pages advance after and known_through. Configurations reproduce Lot 9's lost wake-up (NoInvisibleObligation violated), 76af3a54's unconditional fan-in cursor rewind (MonotoneFanInProgress violated), the repaired DirtyDuringLoad frontier passing safety (with out-of-order commits, low replay, and finish invalidation) and monotone progress (N=4, Page=2), and three mutants removing each safety guard.
not_replayed: Every safety and progress configuration is replayed by deterministic unit tests in owner/pubsub/tests.rs: a_read_started_before_an_older_obligation_revisits_the_lower_range replays DirtyFloor::Any; lower_publication_commit_during_load_rewinds_page_cursor replays mut-no-floor-check and mut-advance-under-pending; higher_publication_commit_during_load_preserves_page_cursor_and_known_through replays 76af3a5-rewind and monotone-no-rewind; higher_publication_commit_during_terminal_page_still_rescans_above_known_through replays lot9-lost-wakeup and mut-no-rescan-on-empty.
